answer: Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the basalt of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. A opal of per-task receipts records who did what, and the pigment of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, forfeited on duplicate submission, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
